hero.name: Gerald Cadiz Adorza
hero.summary: As a mobile applications developer, I have extensive experience in both native and cross-platform development for iOS, Android, and Windows. My portfolio includes work with clients across diverse industries, including gaming, e-commerce, airlines, and fintech. I have led teams of developers and QA testers using Agile methodology to deliver high-performance applications.
